explanation: Compared against OEIS A238224: a(n) counts pairs 0 < j < k ≤ n with k ≡ 1 (mod j) and π(jn) | π(kn); the conjecture is a(n) > 0 for n > 1. The definition enumerates k = jq + 1 with 1 ≤ q ≤ (n-1)/j, which is exactly the k ∈ (j, n] with k ≡ 1 mod j (including j = 1), and the tests match the data. Faithful.
